visualCharacteristics.purpose: Homepage lead banner: full-bleed photo with left-aligned H1, tagline and CTA buttons
visualCharacteristics.description: New variant (no existing hero variants in project): Full-bleed photo, left-aligned H1, tagline and two filled CTAs, brand graphic accent Full-bleed photo background (student portrait) with brand graphic; text left. Visual tree marks it colored because of the herobanner paint, but the photo background belongs to the hero block, so the section is not styled.

cells: heading, subheading, CTA links (contact variant: also H3 groups for side-by-side items)

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: H1, tagline paragraph, CTA links (each link in its own paragraph; consecutive link paragraphs are grouped into a button row)

usage: Top-of-page hero with a photo background and primary calls to action.
reuseGuidance: Use for any page-leading photo banner with left-aligned text. For centered text over a dark photo use hero-overlay; for contact options use hero-contact.
